description: Verify that UDP receive operations return the source IP address correctly to the upper layer (RFC 768 'User Interface' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Like _03 but for src_ip. Applications need to know which host the datagram came from — the receive primitive must report the actual src_ip on the wire.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: UDP datagram with a known src_ip = HOST_X
2. Tester → DUT: OpGetReceivedUdp UT-query

3. Observation:
   • UT Confirmation reports src_ip == HOST_X   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Reported src_ip matches what was sent.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_field_mismatch — DUT reported a different src_ip
• Fail_timeout — UT-query never returned

verdicts.Fail_field_mismatch: DUT received UDP with wrong src_ip in confirmation
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No UT confirmation for src_ip check
